statement: You are given an integer array nums and an integer k. Return the k-th largest value in nums.
This means the k-th value when nums is sorted from largest to smallest, so repeated values count separately; it is not the k-th largest distinct value.

A min-heap of size k solves it without sorting everything: push each value, and whenever the heap grows past k values remove its smallest. After the last value, the heap holds the k largest values and its root is the answer.

examples.explanation: From largest to smallest the values are 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, so the 2nd largest is 5. The final heap holds 5 and 6, with 5 at the root.
The three largest values are 20, 15 and 10. The smallest of them, 10, is the 3rd largest.
Duplicates count individually: in order the values are 5, 5, 5, 1, so the 2nd largest is still 5.
